trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. The last one to land is usually A Long Road (100% completion) — once it pops, the platinum follows immediately. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 and about 200 hours, all single-player, no online trophies.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It unlocks automatically as you play — you cannot miss it.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 1 of the campaign. Automatic — it pops at the end of the chapter.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 2 of the campaign. Automatic — it pops at the end of the chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 3 of the campaign. Automatic — it pops at the end of the chapter.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 4 of the campaign. Automatic — it pops at the end of the chapter.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the final mission and finish the campaign (Chapter 5). Automatic. After the credits you keep free-roaming Leonida, so nothing after this point is locked off.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Breakfast Run during the campaign. Automatic as you play through the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist (a Chapter 3 mission). Automatic as you play through the story.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Child's Play during the campaign. Automatic as you play through the story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Headliners during the campaign. Automatic as you play through the story.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown (a Chapter 4 mission). Automatic as you play through the story.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory during the campaign. Automatic as you play through the story.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story (work done earlier still counts). PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% of true completion — the thresholds are lenient: 15 of 18 card sets, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts. Both PowerPyx and the guides rank it the hardest trophy in the set.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts — stunt jumps and unique stunts across Leonida. There are 397 stunts in the game, so you need just over half; 300 count toward 100%. Track your count in the Progress menu and grab stunts as you drive between missions.
trophies.source_name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Play one round of every activity type the map offers — 9 types in all. Any single session of each type counts; you do not need to win or finish them all.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge has its own gold score — retry them freely, nothing here is missable or timed against the story.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. You only need one win per location, so move on as soon as each race pops.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each distinct race event counts once, any race type. Work through the race markers on the map after the story.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Challenge Cal at a fishing spot and out-fish him — the fishing challenges are the same activity you use to practise, so go in once you know the timing.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — play a full game at any arcade cabinet in Leonida until it ends. Any cabinet, any game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy. Play Andy's mission chain as it appears and finish his final mission. Side chains unlock during and after the story — check the map for Andy's marker when you free-roam.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy. Play Kenton's mission chain as it appears and finish his final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy. Play Billy's mission chain as it appears and finish his final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida — the ? encounters on the map. Each strand is a short chain; eight finished strands pop the trophy. This is PowerPyx's Step 3 work, after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy. Play Randy's mission chain as it appears and finish his final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy. Play Tyrone's mission chain as it appears and finish his final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts twice. THE ONE TO WATCH: the first meditation is Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth — talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. It is gone after Chapter 1 and it is not confirmed whether it is required, so do it while you can. There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus — keep a manual save at the start of every chapter (15 manual slots plus one autosave).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy. Follow Bret's hunting chain and take down the unique animal he points you at. It pops when the hunt is complete.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets hidden around Leonida; you need 15 full sets for 100%, so this pops on the way to A Long Road.
trophies.source_name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations — the in-game photo/tagging activity. Open WAiNK It at 100 different spots across the map; each new location counts once.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges — the open-world feats tracked in the Progress menu. 70 of 80 challenges count toward 100%, so keep going past 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, reach a 4-star wanted level and then lose the heat — break line of sight and stay out of the search area until it cools. It only counts with your partner present; a solo escape does not.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level — keep the heat on through all three robberies. Plan a route of three nearby shops before you start.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — drive or ride 100 different vehicle models; the game logs each new one as discovered. Check Progress to see how many you have, and try anything you have not driven yet.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a fight where enemies are clustered together and drop five before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — get a plane on the runway and take off without a scheduled flight. Stealing a plane and lifting off is the reading of the description.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get a Rhino tank involved — raise your wanted level until the military responds with a Rhino, then take the fight to the tank. No confirmed step-by-step exists at launch; the description is the only hint, so expect this one to need a high wanted level and heavy firepower.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — go in quiet, avoid the cameras and guards, and get out before the alarm. A stealth approach with no shooting and no alerts is what counts.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape — five separate bank robberies, getting clear of the wanted level after each one.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape — hit a truck on the road, crack it, grab the cash and lose the heat.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — visit all 52 areas of the map. The Progress menu tracks which areas you have seen; mop up the ones left after the story.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang. Gang operations show on the map once discovered.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. No confirmed method exists at launch — PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known — so the description is the guide: find a bar or spot on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, take in the view. Do not trust any specific location a forum post claims until a guide confirms it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car out through a showroom's glass front. No confirmed method exists at launch (PowerPyx lists it as not yet known); the description is the guide.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — play a game of bowling there. The related one-off is Ten Pin: knock someone over with a melee drive-by.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — raise both Jason's and Lucia's Strength attributes to maximum. Train both characters' Strength through the activities that build it.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — every choice that shifts your profile counts, so it builds up across normal play. One warning from the guides: do not push toward the Irredeemable profile, which is permanent.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — trigger a hidden second-chance event. No confirmed trigger exists at launch (PowerPyx lists it as not yet known). The description points at a retry or second-chance moment; it may pop during normal play, so do not chase a specific spot until a guide confirms one.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — witness something strange. No confirmed trigger exists at launch (PowerPyx lists it as not yet known); it reads as a rare random encounter, so keep playing and it should surface on its own.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock someone down by striking them with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. No confirmed method exists at launch (PowerPyx lists it as not yet known); the description is the guide.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — Marked Bills come from robberies; launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, food, anything; it adds up across every shop in Leonida, so it pops naturally if you buy gear as you go.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties — buy every garage on the map. Save up and sweep them in one pass after the story.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — open the app on your phone and register 10 different vehicles you own or find.
